clue.text: Judges, not for the first time, get credit

definitions.text: Judges, not for the first time

parts.note: to get or gain a reward is to reap it
credit in the sense of acclaim is praises

explanation.surface: Someone is told that repeated judging will earn them recognition.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'get credit' as REAP PRAISES and run the two words together.
explanation.definitionFit: To judge something again, a second time over, is to reassess or re-evaluate it.

clue.text: Save about a hundred extra

parts.note: re is Latin for about, as in business letters
C is the Roman numeral for one hundred
over means extra or left over, surplus

explanation.surface: A request to keep back roughly a hundred more of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To save a lost thing or a bad situation is to retrieve or regain it.

clue.text: Putting a point, established an advantage

parts.note: S, south, is a point of the compass
set means fixed or established

explanation.surface: Someone scoring a point has secured a lead in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is a useful quality or resource, a plus in one's favour.

clue.text: Quiet part of Spain which is quite ideal

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for playing quietly
Aragon is a region of north-east Spain

explanation.surface: A tourist praises a peaceful Spanish region as perfect.
explanation.definitionFit: A paragon is a model of excellence, a person or thing beyond improvement.

clue.text: Making a bow out of chagrin

indicators.note: the letters come out of the word chagrin, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A performer forced to take a bow despite their annoyance.
explanation.definitionFit: Curving into the shape of a bow or arc is the act of bending in a curve.

clue.text: A time to restrict entrance

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
to bind is to tie or restrict

explanation.surface: A temporary limit placed on people coming in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' is not a doorway but the verb en-TRANCE, to captivate.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone is to hold them enthralled, as if under a magic charm.

clue.text: Back for the drink left

parts.note: to sup is to drink in sips
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone backing out of a bar, leaving their drink behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To back a cause or person is to champion or uphold it.

clue.text: Exercising care, copper's content, and the man's charged

indicators.note: copper's is the content held inside the rearranged letters
exercising suggests the letters of care are being worked about into a new order

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper, here with its 's

explanation.surface: A careful police officer is happy, and the culprit has been charged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exercising' turns CARE into ACER; 'content' puts CU'S (copper's) inside it, AC-CUS-ER. The definition reads as 'the man who has charged', i.e. brought the accusation.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has brought a charge against another is their accuser, the complainant.

clue.text: Apt to steal

explanation.surface: Is it suitable to steal?
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means fitting or suitable; as a verb it means to take something for one's own use without permission.

clue.text: A crawler many a fellow backed with little hesitation

parts.note: C, the Roman numeral for a hundred, stands for many

indicators.note: backed means the word for a fellow is read from the end

parts.note: a peer is a fellow, an equal
er is a brief hesitant sound in speech

explanation.surface: A flatterer that many a man supported with only a slight pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A creeper is a plant that spreads along the ground, or a fawning person: both crawl.

clue.text: Mean rotters twist-there will be protest made

indicators.note: twist tells us to wring the letters of mean rotters into a new order

explanation.surface: Nasty villains twisting things will provoke an outcry.
explanation.definitionFit: To protest is to object forcefully, to argue against something.

clue.text: Shoot around four in turn

indicators.note: around tells us the word for shoot goes round the outside of four

parts.note: to pot is to shoot game, or to shoot a ball into a pocket
IV is the Roman numeral for four

explanation.surface: A basketball player shooting from four positions in rotation.
explanation.definitionFit: To pivot is to swivel or rotate on a central point.

clue.text: Where people are questioned about their food intake?

definitions.text: Where people are questioned about their food intake?

parts.words: Where people are questioned about their food intake?
parts.note: a room for interrogating suspects is a grilling room, but here it is a restaurant serving grilled food

explanation.surface: A dietary interview room.
explanation.definitionFit: A grillroom is a restaurant specialising in grilled meat, and to grill is to question hard.

clue.text: A sports enthusiast who never looks ahead

definitions.text: A sports enthusiast who never looks ahead

parts.words: A sports enthusiast who never looks ahead
parts.note: a sporty person who faces backwards while moving forwards, as a rower does

explanation.surface: A fan of games who lacks foresight.
explanation.definitionFit: A rower sits facing the stern, so travels with his back to the direction of the boat.

clue.text: Helpful policemen turning in tucked into supper

indicators.note: tucked into means these pieces are placed inside the word for supper

parts.note: supper is an evening meal

indicators.note: turning means the word for policemen is reversed

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British plain-clothes detectives

explanation.surface: Helpful officers spinning round while eating dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes DIC from CID; 'tucked into' places DIC + IN inside MEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something medicinal has healing properties, so it is beneficial to health.

clue.text: Note: don't ignore shine

parts.note: G is a musical note
to listen is to pay attention, not ignore

explanation.surface: An instruction to heed a memo about polishing.
explanation.definitionFit: To glisten is to sparkle or gleam, especially when wet.

clue.text: The screen's to be made by retired solderer, not novice

indicators.note: the letters of solderer are to be remade into a new order, with retired adding that sense

parts.note: L is the learner plate, the sign of a novice

explanation.surface: A church screen is to be constructed by a retired metalworker, not a beginner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not novice' means SOLDERER loses its L; the remaining letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A reredos is an ornamental screen behind a church altar.

clue.text: Former official receiving 51 in aid

indicators.note: receiving means the word for a former official holds the number inside it

parts.note: a reeve was a medieval local magistrate or steward
LI is the Roman numeral for fifty-one

explanation.surface: An ex-officer taking in a number as part of a relief effort.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve someone is to help or ease their distress.

clue.text: The person who's paid for correcting letters

indicators.note: correcting suggests the letters of the word letters are put right in a new order

explanation.surface: A proofreader paid to fix correspondence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'paid' means settled a bill, not received wages.
explanation.definitionFit: One who settles a bill or account has paid off what was owed.

clue.text: The minister given quarters in dull environment is most annoyed

indicators.note: environment means the word for dull surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: mat, or matt, means dull, not glossy
DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a minister's qualification
E and S, east and south, are quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: A clergyman housed in drab surroundings is extremely irritated.
explanation.definitionFit: Maddest is the superlative of mad in its sense of angry or irate.

clue.text: Numbers gamble, and that's a fault

parts.note: M and I are Roman numerals, a thousand and one
a stake is a sum gambled

explanation.surface: Betting on the numbers game is an error.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistake is an error or blunder.

clue.text: Withdraw once pamphlet is taken

parts.note: ex means former, once
a tract is a short pamphlet, often religious

explanation.surface: A leaflet is recalled once it has been removed.
explanation.definitionFit: To extract is to pull out or remove.

clue.text: A local set arranging deals

indicators.note: arranging suggests the letters of a local set are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood group organising transactions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deals' is the verb, as in dealing out cards.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal out is to distribute or apportion shares.

clue.text: Ancient city, a favourite with the artist

parts.note: a pet is a favourite person
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: An old city is a painter's preferred spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Petra is the rock-cut ruined city in Jordan.

clue.text: The value of apple-core and cereal

indicators.note: core means the central letter of the word apple

parts.note: rice is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: Weighing up fruit centres against grain.
explanation.definitionFit: The price of something is its cost or worth.

clue.text: Going on and on, so are lent change

indicators.note: change suggests the letters of are lent are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark that the Lenten season seems endless.
explanation.definitionFit: Something eternal lasts forever, without end.

clue.text: A soldier stationed by gallery when there's trouble

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
the Tate is a London art gallery

explanation.surface: A soldier standing guard at a gallery when there is unrest.
explanation.definitionFit: To agitate is to stir up or disturb.

clue.text: Making much of every little thing

definitions.text: Making much of every little thing

parts.words: Making much of every little thing
parts.note: making a small thing into a larger image, as a photographic blow-up does

explanation.surface: Overreacting to every minor detail.
explanation.definitionFit: An enlargement is a magnified photograph, making something bigger.
